art: 1024-square RGBA atlas; three scanned grass silhouettes and one generic broad-leaved herb; transparent orthographic emission bake, no environment/background or baked sun direction
source_integrity: Source catalog MD5 checked on download; individual SHA256 recorded in each source.json; required ignored inputs restored through game-assets.lock.json
runtime: One shared compressed mipmapped atlas. Three crossed quads close, two middle; distant canonical micro-cells use four/two/one cards. Existing root buffers, ecological placement and camp clearing are shared with blades.
limitations: Generic herb representation does not imply every herb is literally nettle. Source model vertices are offline authoring inputs and are not submitted for every runtime plant. Native visual/performance acceptance is recorded separately.
rejected: Initial continuous GroundFoliageAtlasV1 cards produced rectangular sward patches; replaced by this isolated model bake.
